description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data already imported for SPY, AAPL, and MSFT (January 2023 through December 2024).

A swing trader wants to create a reusable chart template with their preferred indicator setup. This template should be saved so it can be quickly applied to any instrument in the future, eliminating the need to manually add indicators each time.

Your task: Open a chart for AAPL with daily bars. Configure the following indicators on the chart:
- EMA (Exponential Moving Average) with Period = 9
- EMA (Exponential Moving Average) with Period = 21
- RSI (Relative Strength Index) with Period = 14 displayed in a separate panel
- MACD with Fast = 12, Slow = 26, Signal = 9 displayed in a separate panel

Then save this chart configuration as a reusable chart template named 'SwingTrading'.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
